title: Portrait of Shaikh Muinuddin Chishti
subject: History
caption: Portrait of Shaikh Muinuddin Chishti as described in 'Munis al Arwah'.
altText: A photorealistic, high‑resolution portrait of Shaikh Muinuddin Chishti, a 13th‑century Sufi saint, shown with a long white beard, simple earth‑toned robe, folded turban, and prayer‑bead necklace. He is set against a plain white background. Black arrows and labels clearly identify the turban, beard, robe, prayer beads, and include a caption with his name and title, making it an accurate educational textbook illustration.
